theorem_bundle.name: PROPER_MASK_BOUNDARY_REACHABILITY_V1
theorem_bundle.statement: Let D be any induced subgraph of the final dynamic graph and F a proper subset of [4]. The predicate rho_D(F)=1 iff G[D] has a proper coloring phi with phi(v) in A(v) cap F and colors(phi(D))=F exactly is decidable constructively in polynomial time using only the known P7-free List-3 backend.
proof: G[D] is an induced subgraph of the original P7-free graph, hence P7-free.
If D is empty then only F=empty is exactly reachable; if D is nonempty then F=empty is unreachable.
For nonempty proper F, |F|<=3. Enumerate one distinct witness w_c for each c in F, force w_c=c, and restrict every vertex list to A(v) cap F.
Each resulting instance uses one common palette F of size at most 3, so after relabeling it is a P7-free List-3 instance.

If one instance succeeds, every color of F appears and no outside color appears, yielding exact mask F. Conversely any exact-F coloring supplies one witness vertex per color and therefore appears in one enumerated branch.
theorem_bundle.complexity: For one F, at most |D|^|F| <= |D|^3 List-3 calls; over all proper masks only a constant factor is added.
theorem_bundle.reconstruction: Store the successful exact-F coloring witness.

theorem_bundle.name: NONEMPTY_COMPONENT_FULL_MASK_BAD_V1
theorem_bundle.statement: For every nonempty residual component C under any component base-list system over [4], mu_C([4])=0.
theorem_bundle.proof: For F=[4], every residual list is B_C(v)\F=empty; a nonempty graph cannot be list-colored from empty lists.
theorem_bundle.consequence: Among the 168 abstract monotone tables, only 167 satisfy this necessary actual-nonempty-component condition. This strengthens only the actual-component control space; C0's <=168 bound remains valid.

theorem_bundle.name: B_C_REACHABILITY_AWARE_NEUTRALITY_IFF_V1
theorem_bundle.setup: Fix a residual component C, dynamic b, its internal message mu_C, exact palette A(b), and common baseline D^-=D_C\{b} for the state in which b is complete, or D_C for the anticomplete state. Compare only source-consistent alternatives with all other local boundary structure frozen.
theorem_bundle.source_guard: If D^-=empty, the anticomplete alternative would make C uncoupled. Sealed C2 proves every residual component in the final state has D_C nonempty, so such a two-sided source-consistent transition does not exist and mu_C(empty) is never queried.
theorem_bundle.delta: Delta_BC(C,b)={(F,alpha): F proper subset [4], rho_{D^-}(F)=1, alpha in A(b), and mu_C(F)!=mu_C(F union {alpha})}.
theorem_bundle.monotonicity_fact: Whenever mu_C(F)!=mu_C(F union {alpha}), necessarily alpha notin F and the only possible direction is mu_C(F)=1, mu_C(F union {alpha})=0.
theorem_bundle.iff: Delta_BC is empty iff the anticomplete and complete states induce the same local component-boundary feasibility relation on every proper list-respecting coloring of G[D^- union {b}].
proof_forward: Take any legal local boundary coloring gamma. Let F=colors(gamma(D^-)) and alpha=gamma(b).
If F=[4], then F union {alpha}=F and the two mu values coincide trivially.
If F is proper, rho_{D^-}(F)=1 by restriction of gamma. Delta empty therefore gives equal mu values.
proof_reverse: Take (F,alpha) in Delta_BC and an exact-F rho witness on D^-.
Because the two mu values differ, alpha notin F. Set b=alpha.
Then b has a color different from every vertex of D^-; hence this is a proper list-respecting coloring of G[D^- union {b}] regardless of b-D^- edges.
The component feasibility values differ exactly by the two mu entries, giving a genuine local-boundary distinguishing coloring.
theorem_bundle.nonneutral_certificate: F, alpha, exact-F coloring witness on D^-, C0 coloring witness for the good mu=1 side, and the sealed bad table entry for the mu=0 side.
theorem_bundle.ceiling: PROVED_NONNEUTRAL applies to the local component-boundary relation only; no whole-U coloring is inferred.

theorem_bundle.name: C_X0_RECOMPILED_MESSAGE_REACHABILITY_IFF_V1
theorem_bundle.setup: Compare two component base-list systems for the same nonempty C differing only by one selected C-X0 fixed-color identity incidence. D_C and the dynamic boundary graph remain unchanged.
theorem_bundle.compilation: Compile mu_C^0 and mu_C^1 separately with the sealed C0 method. Each needs at most 15 nonempty-mask P7-free List-3 calls and stores witnesses for good reachable masks.
theorem_bundle.delta: Delta_CX0={F proper subset [4]: rho_{D_C}(F)=1 and mu_C^0(F)!=mu_C^1(F)}.
theorem_bundle.iff: Delta_CX0 is empty iff the two base-system states induce the same local component-boundary feasibility relation on every legal coloring of D_C.
proof: D_C is nonempty by C2, so every actual boundary coloring uses a nonempty mask.
If a boundary coloring uses F=[4], both messages are 0 by NONEMPTY_COMPONENT_FULL_MASK_BAD_V1.
Every other actual boundary mask is proper and is captured exactly by rho_{D_C}. Thus equality on all reachable proper masks is necessary and sufficient.
If Delta_CX0 is nonempty, its rho witness is an explicit legal local boundary coloring on which the two component states differ.
theorem_bundle.reconstruction: For a neutral quotient, solving may forget which of the two component states was used, but reconstruction retains a pointer to the actual source state and fetches that state's C0 witness table.

theorem_bundle.name: COMPONENT_TRANSITION_SIGNATURE_V1
theorem_bundle.statement: The local feasibility semantics of the declared component-mediated transitions factor through constant-size signatures after polynomial compilation.
B_C_signature: 15 proper-mask rho bits for D^-; under two-sided source-consistency the empty bit is 0
canonical 64-slot Delta_BC bitset indexed by (F,alpha), with full-mask/trivial union slots fixed 0
theorem_bundle.adequacy: Equal signatures imply identical classification of the declared local component-boundary feasibility transition. Reconstruction is state-aware through an external pointer to the actual component/message witness table.
theorem_bundle.nonclaim: This constant-size local signature does not bound how many transition occurrences interact globally through shared dynamic vertices.

lifecycle.proper_mask_calls: At most O(|D|^3*T_L3(|D|)) per rho signature up to constant mask factors.
lifecycle.all_BC_pairs: At most O(n^2) component/dynamic candidates, giving a crude polynomial O(n^5*T_L3(n)) total bound before caching.
lifecycle.C_X0: Each affected base-system state uses <=15 C0 List-3 calls plus a rho signature; even O(n^2) candidate identity transitions remain polynomial.
lifecycle.list3_backend_contract: Uses only the published constructive polynomial List-3 algorithm for P7-free graphs on common palettes of size at most three.
